title: Before and After Numbers Worksheets for Kindergarten – Free Printable
intro: Teach before and after as one step in the counting sequence.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Point to the given number on a number path and model one step back and one step forward.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Start with a number path: write 1 through 9 on separate cards. Find 6. Touch the card immediately to its left: 5. Return to 6 and touch the card immediately to its right: 7.

Read the three numbers together: 5, 6, 7. The count changes by one at each step. Five goes in the Before box and seven goes in the After box.

Ask your student

Which number comes just before this one?

If your student needs help

If the student skips a number, count through a short part of the sequence together.
